name: web-design-system
description: A perceptually-accurate color system for web/product design (OKLCH, semantic tokens, WCAG-verified contrast, dark mode) paired with a forceful anti-slop negative-design checklist that blocks the generic AI-generated web aesthetic — gradient hero, glass cards, bento-by-default, Inter-everywhere, giant centered headline, floating shadow cards, vague marketing copy — unless a specific reason justifies it.
